title: ADR-004: Modular monolith with ports only at realistic migration boundaries
summary: Chose a single-package modular monolith with ports only where a second implementation or per-environment swap is expected; rejected separate services on day one.
notes: Status is Proposed (amended by ADR-010), so locked is false despite ADR type from manifest. Output filename omits the 8-hex source_hash suffix because the classifier had no hashing tool available; orchestrator should rename per the naming rule if required.
